description: Get WhatsApp chats sorted by recent activity. Note: the "lastMessage" field is the newest event of ANY type (a call shows as type "call_log" with an empty body, media as "image"/"video", etc.) - NOT necessarily the last text message, and chat order reflects any activity, not just texts. To read actual conversation content, use list_messages.

include_last_message.description: Whether to include the last message details

limit.description: Maximum number of chats to return

name: list_chats
